rows.en: Yes… We're worried about Dr. Namikawa. If there's anything we can do too…
Hey, Yellow! You're late! Where were you?
Er, well… I was scoutin' out the area 'round the scene.
I see… Blue, tell him.

Huh… y-yes, sir…

Daita, you've got curry all around your mouth…
Er, well… this here is…
Looks like your belly's full, so move out! I'm counting on you all!
Yes, sir!
Kiete… koshi… kirekirete…
What did you say?
I said "Me… you… frieeend…" Or I meant to.
Are you sure about that?

Well… I know quite a bit about space languages.

But… I've never actually talked to a real alien.
All right, let's go!
Huh, we're going already!?
I'm counting on you, Ide, Hayata! Rescue Dr. Namikawa, whatever it takes.
If only it goes that smoothly…
Wh-whoa-whoa-whoa! A Black Cross Army ambush! The operation's failed right off the bat!?
Damn… and we haven't even talked to the alien yet.
Hup! Leave this to us!

…!?

You're from EAGLE? Right, I'm counting on you! Let's go, Ide!
Play ball, Gorenger! Get them!

Security Team, arriving!

The TDF has ordered us to support the Science Patrol and help secure the related facilities. We look forward to working with you.
Ide… It's probably on the upper floor. I'll keep watch here, then.
Ah, I knew it… So I'm the one who has to talk to it in space language? R-r-right!
Um, uh… Will I need the Super Gun?
Hm? Let's hope you won't…
Um, uh… If the talks turn sour, I'm counting on you.
If you get far enough for them to turn sour, that'd be something.
Fair point…
It's the Black Cross Army!
Right, let's help rescue Dr. Namikawa too!
Whoa, it's the Black Cross Army!
Right, let's help rescue Dr. Namikawa too!
All alone at last… Okay, be a man! You can do it!
Fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh!
Th-there it is already! Kie… kie, koshi, koshi… eeek!
Huh… walk, you say? Okay, okay. I'll go wherever you want.

How far are we going?

Huh!? It disappeared… Where'd it go?

Hm? That's Arashi! Heeey, Arashi! You're all right?
Your space language is hard to understand. So we are borrowing this man's brain to use your words.
Huh!? N-n-no way? Eeek!? I'm hopeless…
Calm down, Ide!
H-Hayata! You came?
What is your purpose in coming to Earth?
Our purpose… in coming to planet M240, which you call Earth, is…
Their purpose… What is that purpose?
Cap…

So…

your planet, "Baltan", exploded because of a mad scientist's experiment.

You were traveling through space at the time, so you lost your home, and had no choice but to wander in search of a world where you could survive.

Then your spaceship's gravity balance broke down, and you stopped at Earth to repair it… Is that it?

Then let me ask… Why did you land here?
Because here were the diodes needed for the gravity balance, and a human with the knowledge and skill needed for the repair.
You mean Dr. Namikawa? But why did you take the lives of the other staff?
Lives? I do not understand… What is life?
What do you intend to do from now on?
Our journey is now over. Earth will be a pleasant place for us to live. We will live on Earth.
What!?
How shameless can they be?
…Very well.
Whaaat!?

If you adapt to Earth's customs and ways and obey Earth's laws, that isn't impossible.

How many of you are there?
About 2.03 billion.
Hey, what did you say!?

Above this place is a spaceship you cannot see.

Inside it, we sleep, shrunk to about the size of the bacteria you know.
Ugh, this is hopeless. The whole world's population put together is only 6.2 billion…
Why not live on Mars?
On Mars there is the Speci… that we hate…
What's wrong? Why have you gone quiet?
That I cannot say…
Tch! Right at the good part… Well, how do you like that.

The talk is over… We will take the Earth!

Aah! Uuugh…
Arashi!? Hey, hang in there!
Wait! What happened to Dr. Namikawa? Where is he?
Whoa! What's this shaking!?
Whoa…!?
Fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh-fwoh!
Hayataaa, Ide!! What's happening? Are you all right?

Cap!

We've lost contact with Hayata and Ide!! Something seems to have happened.
Good grief…
Cap! Isn't there anything we can do?
"Specium"! That must be the substance on Mars it was about to mention.
Specium? Then if we had it, we could beat them? Isn't there any on Earth?
Hmm… But perhaps he could…

uncertain: U04814/U04816: Edogawa's color nicknames キー/アオ rendered 'Yellow'/'Blue' for readability.
U04821/U04849: Ide's 'space language' (from the Ultraman episode) kept as romanized gibberish.
U04857/U04860-U04880: the alien (Baltan) speaks through Arashi; speaker labels are glossary-supplied.
U04871/U04874: 20嬉3000万 / 62嬉 read as 20億3000万 / 62億 (2.03 billion / 6.2 billion).

new_names.why: following スペシウム光線 = Specium Ray
